resources.string: The block works in simple mode through Accessibility. If the device is configured as Device Owner, FocusGuard also adds reinforced protection against uninstall and app controls. You can revoke the entire block early by entering your master password.
Time blocking works without Device Owner through Accessibility. Device Owner is optional and adds reinforced protection against uninstall, Safe Boot and app controls.
Enter your master password to end this time block early. If reinforced protection is active, it is also released when no other protected time block remains.
